system.description:
[Trigger: Instant] This item loses one [Embroidery] tag as a cost. If the [Embroidery] tag reaches zero, the [Broken] tag is added to this item at the end of the scene. You gain the [Flight] state and can use the EX Power "Air Dive". This effect lasts until the end of the scene. A sleeveless torso garment made of rich red fabric with a golden thread embroidery of a phoenix. By releasing the power embedded in the embroidery, the wearer can freely float in the air for a short time.

True Sulfur [Core Material] (500G) + Quilted Armor (1100G) + Scroll of Flight (Intermediate) (320G) + [Magic Catalyst 16] (250G) ×2 + Crafting Cost (780G)
